name: Motto Blocks
author: sebastianpothe

sections.description:
Tagline: Advanced blocks. Reusable styling.

Motto Blocks gives you advanced blocks and a reusable, responsive styling system for modern WordPress sites, making it easier to build consistent layouts, manage shared styles, and keep design decisions scalable.

Development

The human-readable source used to build this plugin’s compiled/minified assets (build/motto-blocks.js and the CSS under assets/css/) is publicly available at github.com/mottoblocks/motto-blocks.

Third-Party Libraries

Motto Blocks bundles Swiper (MIT license) for the Motto Slider block, distributed as a minified build; the unminified source is available from the Swiper GitHub repository. It also bundles the Lucide icon set (ISC license) as local SVG files for the Motto Maps block’s pin icon picker, from the lucide-static package. See THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt in the plugin package for full license texts.

External services

This plugin connects to the Google Maps Platform to display maps in the Motto Maps block.

It only loads when a page contains a Motto Maps block, and only after you configure a Google Maps API key in Settings → Motto Blocks → API. The plugin sends the site administrator’s own API key to Google to load the Maps JavaScript API in the visitor’s browser; no visitor-provided personal data is sent by the plugin itself, though loading any third-party script exposes the visitor’s IP address and browser details to that service, as is standard for any embedded map.

This service is provided by Google: Google Maps Platform Terms of Service, Google Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/motto-blocks directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the block inserter to add blocks, or open block settings where the Styler integrates with supported blocks.
sections.faq:
What WordPress version do I need?

Motto Blocks requires WordPress 6.5 or higher and PHP 7.4 or higher.

Where can I get help or documentation?

Visit mottoblocks.com for product information and support channels.

Is there a Pro version?

A Pro add-on with additional blocks and features is planned, but not available yet. The free plugin is fully usable on its own. Follow mottoblocks.com for updates.
sections.changelog:
0.1.2

  • Directory listing: declare the editor script handle in each block’s block.json so the WordPress.org Plugin Directory can index all blocks.

0.1.1

  • Styler: responsive styling workflow in the block editor for supported surfaces (classes, design tokens, and related controls).
  • Layout: Motto Container.
  • Actions: Motto Button, Motto Buttons.
  • Media: Motto Image, Motto SVG.
  • Lists: Motto List and Motto List Item.
  • Carousel: Motto Slider and Motto Slide.
  • Tabs: Motto Tabs, Tab Container, Tab Panels, Tab Panel, and Tab Button.
  • Accordion: Motto Accordion and Motto Accordion Item.
  • Navigation: Motto Classic Menu.
  • Maps: Motto Maps.
  • Utility: Motto Counter.
  • First release packaged for the WordPress.org plugin directory.

motto/svg.name: motto/svg
motto/svg.title: Motto SVG
motto/svg.description: Render a Lucide icon, uploaded SVG, or inline SVG markup.

motto/tabs.name: motto/tabs
motto/tabs.title: Motto Tabs
motto/tabs.description: Tabbed content block with InnerBlocks-based tab panels.

mottoAI.description: Tabbed content block. Structure: motto/tabs → [motto/tab-container, motto/tab-panels]. The tab-container holds one motto/tab-button per tab; the tab-panels holds one motto/tab per tab. Each button and its panel share the same tabId string. Set activeTabId on motto/tabs to the first tab's tabId.

motto/image.name: motto/image
motto/image.title: Motto Image
motto/image.description: Image block with shared media source control and Styler support.

mottoAI.description: Image block for displaying images. AI cannot set the url attribute — leave it empty; the user will pick the media from the editor.

motto/counter.name: motto/counter
motto/counter.title: Motto Counter
motto/counter.description: Animated counter block with inline prefix, suffix, and label.

motto/list.name: motto/list
motto/list.title: Motto List
motto/list.description: List block with configurable default, image, icon, SVG, counter, or no bullets.

motto/maps.name: motto/maps
motto/maps.title: Motto Maps
motto/maps.description: Google Maps block with customizable pins.

motto/classic-menu.name: motto/classic-menu
motto/classic-menu.title: Motto Classic Menu
motto/classic-menu.description: Classic menu block rendered from WordPress menus.

motto/container.name: motto/container
motto/container.title: Motto Container
motto/container.description: Flexible container block for grouping content.

mottoAI.description: Primary layout container. Use for sections, rows, cards, column wrappers, and any structural wrapper. To create a multi-column row: set display:flex + flex-wrap:wrap + gap on the outer container; set flex:1 1 <min-width> on each inner container. Supports mottoStyler for all CSS. Accepts any inner blocks.

features.overlay: Set overlayEnabled:true to add a color or gradient overlay. overlayColor (CSS color), overlayOpacity (0-1, default 0.4), overlayStyle ('color' or 'gradient'), overlayGradient (CSS gradient string).
features.parallax: Set backgroundParallax:true to enable parallax scroll on the background image. backgroundParallaxOffset controls depth (number, default 120).
features.backgroundImage: backgroundImageUrl and backgroundImageEnabled control the background image. AI cannot pick media URLs — only set these in modify mode when a URL is already present.
features.linkContainer: Set linkContainerEnabled:true to make the entire container a link. linkContainerUrl (string), linkContainerNewTab (bool), linkContainerNoFollow (bool).

motto/accordion.name: motto/accordion
motto/accordion.title: Motto Accordion
motto/accordion.description: Accordion block with item-based toggle panels.

mottoAI.description: Accordion block for FAQ or toggle content. Add motto/accordion-item blocks inside it. closeOtherItems (bool): if true, opening one item automatically closes the others.

motto/slider.name: motto/slider
motto/slider.title: Motto Slider
motto/slider.description: Slider block with configurable Swiper options.

mottoAI.description: Slider/carousel block powered by Swiper. Add motto/slide blocks inside it.

features.slides: slidesPerView (number, default 1) or set slidesPerViewAuto:true to size by content. spaceBetween (number px, default 16). centeredSlides (bool).
features.mousewheel: mousewheelEnabled (bool): enables mouse wheel control. mousewheelForceToAxis (bool, default true), mousewheelReleaseOnEdges (bool, default true), mousewheelSensitivity (number, default 1).
features.autoplay: autoplayEnabled (bool): enables autoplay. autoplayDelay (number ms, default 3000).
features.navigation: navigation (bool, default true): shows prev/next arrow buttons.
features.pagination: pagination (bool, default true): shows dot indicators. paginationClickable (bool, default true).

motto/buttons.name: motto/buttons
motto/buttons.title: Motto Buttons
motto/buttons.description: Buttons container block that only accepts Motto Button items.

mottoAI.description: Button group container. Must contain motto/button inner blocks. Use for CTA groups.
examplePrompts: add two buttons side by side

motto/slide.name: motto/slide
motto/slide.title: Slide
motto/slide.description: Single slide item for Motto Slider.

mottoAI.description: Single slide inside a motto/slider. Accepts any inner blocks as slide content (images, headings, containers, etc.).

motto/tab-button.name: motto/tab-button
motto/tab-button.title: Tab Button
motto/tab-button.description: Single navigation button for Motto Tabs.

mottoAI.description: Navigation button inside motto/tab-container. Set tabId to a unique string shared with its corresponding motto/tab panel. Content is a core/paragraph text child plus an optional motto/svg icon child, in either order.
Navigation bar inside motto/tabs. Contains one motto/tab-button per tab. Always the first child of motto/tabs, paired with a motto/tab-panels sibling.

motto/accordion-panel.name: motto/accordion-panel
motto/accordion-panel.title: Accordion Panel
motto/accordion-panel.description: Collapsible content panel for a single Motto Accordion item.

mottoAI.description: Content panel inside motto/accordion-item. Accepts any inner blocks as panel content.

motto/list-item.name: motto/list-item
motto/list-item.title: List Item
motto/list-item.description: List item with optional bullet override.

motto/tab.name: motto/tab
motto/tab.title: Tab Panel
motto/tab.description: Single content panel for Motto Tabs.

mottoAI.description: Content panel inside motto/tab-panels. Set tabId to the same unique string as its corresponding motto/tab-button. Accepts any inner blocks as panel content.

motto/accordion-trigger.name: motto/accordion-trigger
motto/accordion-trigger.title: Accordion Trigger
motto/accordion-trigger.description: Trigger button for a single Motto Accordion item.

mottoAI.description: Trigger button inside motto/accordion-item. Content is a core/paragraph text child plus an optional motto/svg icon child, in either order.

Single accordion item. Must be placed inside motto/accordion. Structure: motto/accordion-item → [motto/accordion-trigger, motto/accordion-panel]. isOpen (bool): starts the panel open by default. Set the trigger's text on its inner motto/accordion-trigger block.
Content panels container inside motto/tabs. Contains one motto/tab per tab. Always the second child of motto/tabs, paired with a motto/tab-container sibling.

motto/button.name: motto/button
motto/button.title: Button
motto/button.description: Button block with optional image, Lucide, or inline SVG icon.

mottoAI.description: Individual button. Must be placed inside motto/buttons. Key attributes: text (string, button label), url (string, href), linkTarget ('_blank' for new tab), noFollow (bool). Supports optional icon.
examplePrompts: create a call to action button
